安装复用 CLI 的归属检查、写前备份与记账失败回滚；过期预览或配置变化会拒绝写: Install reuses the CLI's ownership checks, pre-write backups, and bookkeeping failure rollback; stale previews or config changes will reject the write. After a failure you must preview and authorize again.
安装其他 Agent · 插件中还有更多: Install other agents · More available in plugins
安装状态未验证（读取异常，不代表未安装）: Installation status unverified (read error, does not mean not installed)
按密钥所属套餐选择，不会根据密钥猜测套餐。: Selected by the plan the key belongs to; the plan is not guessed from the key.
按密钥所属套餐选择；Coding Plan 与按量付费的地址不同。: Selected by the plan the key belongs to; Coding Plan and pay-as-you-go use different endpoints.
按描述匹配请求，再交给目标模型。点击规则会在弹窗中编辑。: Matches requests by description, then hands them to the target model. Clicking a rule edits it in a dialog.
按顺序做完三步即可。状态来自本机实读，历史请求不参与判断。: Just complete the three steps in order. Status comes from live local reads; historical requests are not used in the judgement.
把网关地址写入客户端配置，普通命令即走网关: Write the gateway address into the client config; normal commands then go through the gateway
包含当前不可用的模型或模型组，请先补充或启用模型来源。: Contains models or model groups that are currently unavailable; add or enable a model source first.
保留明确的 Auto 例外，不继承较低层的固定首选；此项不提供具体模型，继续使用: Keep explicit Auto exceptions; do not inherit fixed preferences from lower layers. This option does not provide a specific model and continues to use rule fallback and the global default.
本地方案数据格式不正确，未自动覆盖。: Local profile data has an invalid format and was not overwritten automatically.
本地模型网关是什么: What is the local model gateway
本机 MCP 提供 DeepSeek Search / Fetch，不依赖生成模: Local MCP provides DeepSeek Search / Fetch; it does not depend on a generative model and does not replace all of the client's native search.
本机没有记忆命名空间。: There is no memory namespace on this machine.
本机没有可写的落点，所以这一步没法继续。每个落点的读取结果见服务清单。: There are no writable targets on this machine, so this step cannot continue. See the service list for the read result of each target.
必须先取得可执行的最新预览。: You must first obtain an executable, up-to-date preview.
别人写的，AIOS 不覆盖: Written by someone else; AIOS does not overwrite it
不可写的落点没有出现在上面——它们来自: Non-writable targets do not appear above — they come from
不启动真实服务进程: Does not start real service processes
不受管或有冲突的目录不允许直接改写。: Unmanaged or conflicting directories cannot be rewritten directly.
不想改真实配置时，用: When you don't want to change the real config, use
不再指定普通对话默认: No longer specify a normal chat default
查看取代它的新记录: View the new record that replaced it
产品声明支持这个客户端，但落点声明表里没有它的位置。: The product declares support for this client, but it has no entry in the target declaration table.
此安装来源尚无受支持的更新方式。: This installation source has no supported update method yet.
此处管理本机网关，注册表属于 Console 服务启动根。切换工作区只改变客户端: The local gateway is managed here; the registry belongs to the Console service startup root. Switching workspaces only changes the scope of client-fact collection, not to a different gateway.
此处推演不读取运行环境覆盖、凭据或额度。保存只写磁盘，运行中的网关需要重启加载；: This simulation does not read runtime overrides, credentials, or quotas. Saving only writes to disk; a running gateway must be restarted to load changes. Check the request log for actual selections.
此客户端尚不支持版本探测: This client does not support version detection yet
此客户端尚无安全接入适配器: This client has no secure-access adapter yet
此模型组仍被使用，请先修改以下引用：: This model group is still in use; modify the following references first:
此账号不单独配置密钥，运行时继承供应商的密钥配置。: This account does not have a separate key; at runtime it inherits the provider's key configuration.
从此浏览器移除方案，不影响当前草稿或已保存的网关配置。: Remove the profile from this browser; it does not affect the current draft or saved gateway config.
打开「接入」后，网关的模型会作为可选项出现在 agent 的模型列表里；也可在此: After enabling "Connect", the gateway's models appear as options in the agent's model list; you can also select a model directly here. Click to view target and version details.
当前 AIOS 运行时没有安装 DeepSeek Search MCP 入口。: The current AIOS runtime does not have the DeepSeek Search MCP entry installed.
当前工作区没有返回客户端事实；配置落点与请求记录分别采集。: The current workspace returned no client facts; config targets and request logs are collected separately.
当前日志内没有请求记录。: There are no request records in the current log.
当前筛选条件下没有记录；换一个片或清除筛选。: No records under the current filter; try another slice or clear the filter.
当前视图每 2.5 秒读取一次。: The current view reads every 2.5 seconds.
当前视图未轮询。: The current view is not polling.
当前运行时不支持技能清单：: The current runtime does not support the skill list:
当前运行时不支持角色目录：: The current runtime does not support the role directory:
当前运行时未返回受支持的 Skills 清单契约。: The current runtime did not return a supported Skills list contract.
当前运行时未返回受支持的 Subagents 目录契约。: The current runtime did not return a supported Subagents directory contract.
当前只有一个合资格的已绑定模型，网关可直接选择，无需分类器。请求仍可能因协议翻译: Only one eligible bound model is present; the gateway can select it directly without a classifier. Requests may still fail due to protocol translation, authentication, or quota; the config list does not guarantee generation availability.
的普通对话按默认规则继承（含已有无角色规则），角色任务继承全局角色规则。需要不同: normal chat is inherited by default rules (including existing no-role rules), and role tasks inherit global role rules. Add an exception only when different behaviour is needed.
第三步跑真实 `aios mcp add --dry-run`：它不改文件，只告: Step 3 runs the real `aios mcp add --dry-run`: it does not change files, only tells you what it plans to write. Actual writing requires separate authorization.
第三方渠道可能只接受其中一种。官方 Anthropic 使用 x-api-key: Third-party channels may accept only one of them. Official Anthropic uses x-api-key. Model discovery, classification, and forwarding use the same setting.
调整搜索或来源筛选，查看当前供应商的其他模型。: Adjust search or source filters to see other models from the current provider.
方案名称已存在，请换一个名称。: Scheme name already exists; please choose a different name.
方案已应用到草稿，尚未写入配置。: Scheme applied to the draft, not yet written to the configuration.
分类器需给出 0..1 的自报置信度；低于门槛时回落到默认路由，不在猜测上发往意: The classifier must return a self-reported confidence of 0..1; when it is below the threshold, fall back to the default route and do not send to the intent model on a guess. Leave empty to disable classification.
分类失败会返回普通路由；若没有兼容的路由，请求仍可能失败。: Classification failure falls back to normal routing; if no compatible route exists, the request may still fail.
服务装在哪里、谁的、读没读到。: Where the service is installed, whose it is, and whether it could be read.
复制失败：请手动选中内容复制。: Copy failed: please select the content and copy it manually.
该技能未声明支持此范围，请更换范围。: This skill has not declared support for this scope; please change the scope.
该客户端不参与网关模型分配；保留配置不表示会向该客户端派发模型。: This client does not participate in gateway model allocation; keeping the configuration does not mean a model will be dispatched to it.
个可选来源。清单的客户端根目录不是已安装或运行中的证明；加载状态未提供证据时显示: optional sources. A client root directory in the list is not proof of installation or running; when the load status provides no evidence, show "Unknown".
各协议结果不同，请查看 byProtocol，不汇总为单一模型。: Results differ by protocol; check byProtocol — they are not aggregated into a single model.
更新命令已完成并重新读取版本；客户端不会自动重启。: Update command completed and the version was re-read; the client will not restart automatically.
更新预览与所选客户端不一致。: The update preview does not match the selected client.
工作区清单没有返回可读的 JSON: Workspace list did not return readable JSON
供应商、模型和模型分配将恢复到最近一次读取的配置。此操作不会改写磁盘。: Providers, models, and model allocations will be restored to the most recently read configuration. This operation does not rewrite the disk.
供应商标识只能使用字母、数字、点、下划线和短横线。: A provider identifier may only use letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
供应商配置无效，不能确定路由。: Provider configuration is invalid; routing cannot be determined.
关闭时使用普通路由，不调用分类器。: When off, use normal routing and do not call the classifier.
管理接口返回格式无效。: Management API returned an invalid format.
管理接口没有返回可读的 JSON。: Management API did not return readable JSON.
规划 / 审查用强模型，实现用快而省的模型；通道故障时自动切到备用。: Use a strong model for planning/review and a fast, inexpensive model for implementation; automatically switch to a backup on channel failure.
还差一步就能开始用: One more step before you can start using it
还没有方案 · 保存当前设置，之后一键切回: No scheme yet · Save the current settings to switch back with one click later
还没有方案。可以把当前草稿的角色覆盖保存为一个命名方案。: No scheme yet. You can save the current draft's role overrides as a named scheme.
换个关键词或选择全部结果。: Try another keyword or select all results.
换一个词，或按回车让本机 CLI 再搜一次。: Try another word, or press Enter to have the local CLI search again.
恢复此客户端全部继承: Restore all inheritance for this client
计数来自当前保留的网关日志，不是客户端在线状态或累计用量。: Counts come from currently retained gateway logs, not from client online status or cumulative usage.
记一次召回反馈（aios memo useful <id>），它会提高这条以后被: Record a recall feedback (aios memo useful <id>); it increases the chance that this entry is recalled later.
记忆按 space 与 scope 陈列；顶部的项目选择器只决定配置目标，不筛记: Memories are organized by space and scope; the project selector at the top only determines the configuration target and does not filter memories — the memo store has no per-project separation.
技能操作错误字段无效。: Skill operation error field is invalid.
技能操作返回了不完整的落点结果。: Skill operation returned an incomplete placement result.
技能操作结果缺少落点，或与请求的预览 / 写入模式不一致。: Skill operation result lacks a placement target, or does not match the requested preview/write mode.
技能操作没有返回可验证的结果。: Skill operation did not return a verifiable result.
技能来自哪里，落在哪些客户端。: Where skills come from and which clients they land in.
监听已启动，但当前没有就绪模型: Listener started, but there is no ready model currently
监听已启动，但加载的供应商配置无效: Listener started, but the loaded provider configuration is invalid
监听已启动，但模型来源缺少有效凭据: Listener started, but the model source lacks valid credentials
监听已启动，但尚无模型访问配置: Listener started, but there is no model access configuration yet
监听已启动，但无法确认已加载模型的就绪状态: Listener started, but the readiness of loaded models cannot be confirmed
监听已启动，多模型仍需显式默认或角色策略: Listener started, but multiple models still require an explicit default or role policy
将把所有客户端的目标切回保存时的选择。仍需点各客户端的「应用默认目标」写入配置。: This will switch all clients' targets back to the saved selections. You still need to click "Apply default target" on each client to write the configuration.
将从草稿中移除分类器模型与全部意图规则，保持意图分流关闭。不会更改默认分配或客户: This will remove the classifier model and all intent rules from the draft, keeping intent routing disabled. Default allocation and client exceptions are not changed; the configuration is written only after clicking "Save all changes" at the bottom.
将读取磁盘上的最新配置。如有未保存修改，会被替换；这不会更改已保存的配置。: This will read the latest configuration from disk. Unsaved changes will be replaced; this does not change the saved configuration.
将读取所有已保存供应商的上游模型列表，并更新本地目录，不仅是当前选中的供应商。不: This will read the upstream model lists of all saved providers and update the local catalog, not only the currently selected provider. It will not call models to generate content.
将具体模型按顺序组合为一个分配目标。成员顺序参与路由；分类器仍只能选择具体模型。: Combines concrete models in order into one allocation target. Member order affects routing; the classifier can still only select concrete models. Empty groups and old unsupported modes may be retained, but no new allocations can be added.
将使用检测到的安装来源更新客户端程序。此操作可能联网下载；不会自动重启客户端或网: This will update the client program using the detected installation source. The operation may download over the network; it will not automatically restart the client or gateway.
将替换草稿中的全局与客户端角色覆盖，其他设置保持不变。仍需保存全部修改才生效。: This will replace the global and client role overrides in the draft; other settings remain unchanged. You still need to save all changes for it to take effect.
将停止界面托管的网关进程，接入的客户端在网关重新启动前无法路由请求。: This will stop the gateway process managed by the UI; connected clients cannot route requests until the gateway restarts.
角色覆盖方案已保存在此浏览器。: The role override plan has been saved in this browser.
角色目录与证据，不是正在运行的代理。: Role catalog and evidence, not a running agent.
角色任务：运行环境覆盖 → 客户端角色例外 → 全局角色指定 → 角色默认 /: Role tasks: runtime environment override → client role exception → global role assignment → role default / task rules. Only the highest-level preferred option is taken; when the preferred option fails, the task rule's fallback list is used, then the general-chat global default is tried, without re-inheriting level by level.
接入客户端，配置模型来源，让每一次请求都有清晰的去向。: Connect clients, configure model sources, so every request has a clear destination.
接入由程序写入客户端全局配置并备份原值；手动接入步骤见接入手册。: Connection is performed by the program writing to the client's global config and backing up the original value; see the connection manual for manual steps.
仅快照角色矩阵；不包含普通对话默认、客户端普通对话例外或意图分流。: Only snapshots the role matrix; does not include general-chat defaults, client general-chat exceptions, or intent routing.
仅快照全局与客户端角色覆盖，不包含普通对话默认、客户端普通对话例外、供应商、密钥:
Only snapshots global and client role overrides, excluding general-chat defaults, client general-chat exceptions, providers, keys, or intent rules. The plan is saved in this browser and is not synced with the CLI
        ; applying only updates the draft.
仅列出已绑定且启用的模型，以及至少有一个合资格成员的顺序模型组；未验证凭据、额度: Only lists bound and enabled models, plus sequential model groups with at least one eligible member; credentials, quotas, or generation availability are not verified.
仅声明支持 · 本机无落点: Declared support only · no local installation point
仅网关配置推演；不含环境覆盖、意图分类、凭据校验或实时可用性。: Gateway config simulation only; excludes environment overrides, intent classification, credential validation, or real-time availability.
仅显示本次清单返回的目录项；客户端与范围以该条目声明为准。: Only shows directory entries returned by this listing; the client and scope are based on what the entry declares.
仅限声明支持 OpenAI Chat 或 Claude 协议的已绑定模型；实际协: Limited to bound models that declare support for the OpenAI Chat or Claude protocol; actual protocol compatibility, authentication, and quotas are not yet verified.
仅修改共享草稿，不会删除成员模型。存在引用时须先清除引用，不能静默改写分配。: Only modifies the shared draft, does not delete member models. When references exist, they must be cleared first; assignments cannot be silently rewritten.
仅展示决策元数据，不展示请求正文、密钥或响应内容。: Only shows decision metadata, not request bodies, keys, or response content.
仅展示显式配置的模型，内置模板不会自动加入。发现列表不代表凭据、生成或配额已验证: Only shows explicitly configured models; built-in templates are not added automatically. The discovery list does not mean credentials, generation, or quotas have been verified.
经验留下来，下一次接着用。: Keep the experience so it can be used next time.
可发现的客户端来自本机安装；插件提供的条目由插件系统接入。: Discoverable clients come from local installations; entries provided by plugins are integrated via the plugin system.
可选：由分类器根据规则描述判断普通对话的意图，再使用该规则指定的模型。显式指定角: Optional: the classifier determines the intent of general chat based on the rule description, then uses the model specified by that rule. Tasks with an explicitly assigned role do not go through the classifier.
客户端不参与网关分配: Client does not participate in gateway assignment
客户端配置操作已完成并重新读取；请以更新后的状态为准。: The client config operation is complete and has been re-read; please refer to the updated state.
客户端配置落点不能证明已接入网关。: The client config installation point cannot prove that the gateway has been connected.
客户端清单返回格式无效。: Client listing returned an invalid format.
客户端自行选择 · 不固定目标: Client chooses on its own · no fixed target
客户端自行选择保留接入，只清除固定目标，与断开还原不同。: Client self-selection keeps the connection and only clears the fixed target, which is different from disconnecting and restoring.
空模型组可以保留，但至少有一个启用且显式绑定的成员后才能分配。: An empty model group can be kept, but it can only be assigned after it has at least one enabled and explicitly bound member.
快照当前草稿中的角色覆盖。保存方案不会写入网关配置。: Snapshots the role overrides in the current draft. Saving the plan does not write to the gateway config.
快照当前所有客户端的目标选择，之后可一键切回。方案保存在此浏览器。: Snapshots the current target selections of all clients, allowing one-click switch back later. The plan is saved in this browser.
来源未记录。保留已有内容，不补造出处。: Source not recorded. Keep existing content, do not fabricate a source.
来自 aios agents list --json。当前管理接口只提供目录读取: From `aios agents list --json`. The current management interface only provides catalog reading and doctor; it does not provide install, edit, delete, or start.
来自 aios skill list --json；目录登记、实际落点和客户端已: From `aios skill list --json`; catalog registration, actual installation point, and client loading are different facts.
链接目录，请管理源: Link catalog, please manage the source
临时，不进入长期召回: Temporary, does not enter long-term recall
浏览器存储不可用，方案没有保存。: Browser storage unavailable, the plan was not saved.
留空表示不指定固定目标；候选由上方已绑定的模型与模型组决定。: Leaving it blank means no fixed target is specified; candidates are determined by the models and model groups bound above.
留空使用真实上游 ID: Leave blank to use the real upstream ID
留空自动生成「供应商/模型」唯一标识；保存后保持稳定。: Leave blank to auto-generate a unique "provider/model" identifier; it remains stable after saving.
落点状态分别是什么意思: What do the installation point statuses mean?
没有读到客户端条目，请检查上方读取结果。: No client entries were read; please check the read result above.
没有匹配项不代表运行时出错；角色增删改尚未提供。: No matches do not mean a runtime error; role create/update/delete is not yet provided.

自动选择不同于恢复继承：明确的 Auto 覆盖不继承较低层的固定首选，也不提供具: Auto select differs from restore inheritance: an explicit Auto override does not inherit a fixed preference from a lower layer, nor does it provide specific candidates; it continues to use rule fallback and the global default. Model groups route in member order; if the selected group is unavailable, it stops and does not silently switch to another fixed target. Cross-member attempts occur only when a pre-dispatch eligibility check skips a member or the upstream explicitly returns 401 / 402 / 429.
